compressed_uploads.description: Enable compressed uploads (set to zero when errors with uploading occur)

error_on_warnings.description: Show non-zero exit code when warnings are found

language.description: Use Lynis in your own language (by default auto-detected)

machine_role.description: Defines the role of the system (personal, workstation or server)

profile_name.description: Profile name, will be used as title/description

pause_between_tests.description: Number of seconds to pause between every test (0 is no pause)

quick.description: Quick mode (do not wait for keypresses)

refresh_repositories.description: Refresh software repositories to help detecting vulnerable packages

show_tool_tips.description: Show inline tips about the tool

ssl_certificate_paths.description: Locations where to search for SSL certificates (separate paths with a colon)

ssl_certificate_include_packages.description: Include packages in SSL certificate search

test_scan_mode.description: Scan type - how deep the audit should be (light, normal or full)

compliance_standards.description: Compliance standards to audit and report on

upload_server.description: The hostname/IP address to receive the data

upload_options.description: Provide options to cURL (or other upload tool) when uploading data
